requirements.text: Generate and print gate passes directly from Tally invoices with a single click, automatically populating the truck number without re-keying data.
Ensure no truck departs the factory gate without a pre-existing bill or invoice.
Require e-way bill numbers on gate passes for all consignments valued over Rs 1,00,000 prior to gate clearance.
Support manual chit logging at the gate for after-hours night dispatches when the accounting office is closed.
Provide user roles and shift logging for gate guards, accommodating night relief guards like Montu and head guards like Bablu.
Log all dispatch movement details at the gate including date, lorry number, party name, entry time, exit time, and chit or invoice number.
Provide offline local data logging and store-and-forward synchronization to ensure gate operations continue without active network connectivity.
Provide a reconciliation mechanism to link next-day generated Tally invoices back to night manual dispatch chits.

conflicts.about: Dev states every truck has an invoice before departure, but register records show 17 night chit dispatches (13%) executed without prior invoices.
conflicts.resolution: Configure the system to support controlled night chit logging with mandatory next-day invoice reconciliation.

conflicts.about: Bablu claims he is not on shift at night and that Montu writes night chits, but the register attributes 6 night chit entries directly to Bablu.
conflicts.resolution: Enforce individual guard login authentication for every entry to prevent identity sharing or inaccurate logging.

conflicts.about: Data release permission stalemate; Dev refers invoice data approval to Anjali, while Anjali refuses to release sales lists without explicit written authorization from Dev.
conflicts.resolution: Obtain formal written authorization from Dev explicitly approving data extraction from Tally.

conflicts.about: Enforcement of e-way bill validation rules on dispatches; Anjali mandates e-way bill compliance due to statutory risks, whereas Dev deflects decisions regarding e-way bill checks.
conflicts.resolution: Implement mandatory e-way bill validation for high-value consignments based on statutory advice from accounts.

constraints: The gate cabin lacks a wired network connection to the office (200 meters away), and mobile cellular reception is weak and dead near the weighbridge.
System budget is strictly capped at Rs 75,000 total including hardware, with no additional expenditure permitted without Dev's approval.
Register findings rely on hand-copied entries from the paper gate register.
Available historical register audit data spans only a single one-month period (2026-10-01 to 2026-10-31).
register_findings: 123 movements logged 2026-10-01 to 2026-10-31: 106 on invoices, 17 on handwritten chits (13%).
Invoice movements arrive between 09:04 and 19:08 (average dwell 50 min); chit movements arrive between 20:25 and 23:59 (average dwell 24 min).
All 17 chit movements start at or after 20:00: 11 by Montu, 6 by Bablu.
No row falls on a Sunday: all 4 Sundays in the period are empty, and 0 weekdays are also dark.
Invoice GP/26-27/2386 appears 2 times: row 5 on 2026-10-01 (invoice); row 59 on 2026-10-15 (chit).
1 of 17 chit rows carry an invoice number; the rest have none to link to.
123 of 123 vehicle numbers appear only once; not one vehicle returns twice in 123 movements.
The register has no value, weight, or e-way bill columns, so invoice-value rules cannot be checked from this data.
Trucks per active day: min 3, max 6, mean 4.6 over 27 active days.
Source note: Ghosh Polymers gate register, 2026-10-01 to 2026-10-31, copied from the red register by hand.
Requirements, conflicts and constraints were extracted from 52 interview quotes in one LLM call (cache); every register number above was computed by code.
plan: Obtain formal written authorization from management for Tally data integration and export.
Develop a Tally integration module to automatically extract invoice details, vehicle numbers, consignment values, and e-way bill numbers.
Build an offline-capable gate pass application with local storage and store-and-forward capability to tolerate weak network signal.
Implement one-click gate pass generation for daytime invoice-backed dispatches.
Implement a dedicated night dispatch workflow allowing manual chit entry when accounts is closed.
Configure automated compliance rules to mandate e-way bill capture for consignments over Rs 1,00,000.
Create a reconciliation screen for accounts to link next-day Tally invoices to night chits.
Deploy hardware at the gate cabin and conduct user training for all shift guards.
